verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Jira has a REST API: 'Rich APIs' (jira-docs-1) and community users querying data via REST (jira-comm-16, jira-comm-11). Nothing shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and probes of the common spec paths on developer.atlassian.com all returned 404 (jira-probe-2). An API that exists but has no evidenced published spec does not satisfy this story.
